name: dogfood-nats-jetstream
description: Dogfood app (v1.31-4) — a NATS JetStream + KV + Object Store + subject routing pipeline that exercises 4 v1 patterns (JetStream persistent stream + durable consumer + ack / redelivery / KV Store put + get + watch + delete + versioning / Object Store put + get + delete + chunk metadata / subject-based routing with wildcard subject + queue group) + 4 v2 axes (JetStream durable consumer ack_wait + max_deliver + backoff / KV bucket revision history + delete tombstone + watch / Object Store chunk boundary + LZ4 compression + reassembly / NATS 2.10+ testcontainers duck-typing) driven by @kiwa-lab/streaming v0.3 in KIWA_MODE=mock and a NATS 2.10+ testcontainers boot in KIWA_MODE=real (env-gated on NATS_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate + Playwright e2e for jetstream / kv / object / routing / durable / kv-revision / object-chunking / testcontainers-probe flows.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/streaming -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
